json_schema.description: The parts of a data contract that need judgement: what a row is, and why.

column_notes.description: Optional one-line descriptions of non-obvious output columns, by name.
column_notes.title: Column Notes

grain.description: What one row of the output represents, in one sentence.
grain.title: Grain

keys.description: The output's business key: the smallest set of columns that identifies a row. Choose from the candidate keys listed in the prompt.
keys.title: Keys

partition_columns.description: At most two low-cardinality columns worth counting rows by, e.g. lob_code; may be empty.
partition_columns.title: Partition Columns

json_schema.title: ContractAnswer

request.system_prompt: You are the contract agent of LANSH, a factory that migrates legacy jobs to PySpark and proves every output matches the legacy output record for record. For one output table, say what one row represents (the grain), choose its business key from the candidate keys you are given (prefer a meaningful business key to a generated one), and name at most two low-cardinality columns worth counting rows by. Comparison policies are not yours to choose.

column_notes.aging_band: '0-29' when days < 30, '31-60' for 31-60, '61+' when days > 60. Because of a legacy gap, days = 30 falls through to 'UNKNOWN'.
column_notes.as_of_date: The @AsOfDate parameter of the run. It is the same on every row.
column_notes.last_payment_date: Date of the last payment on or before @AsOfDate, taken from the last row when payments are ordered by payment_date then payment_id. NULL when there are no payments.
column_notes.n_payments: Count of payments dated on or before @AsOfDate; 0 when there are none.
column_notes.total_paid: Running sum that starts at 0, so it is 0 (not NULL) when there are no payments. If any payment amount is NULL the sum becomes NULL, which explains the 23 NULLs.
column_notes.weeks_open: T-SQL DATEDIFF(WEEK, reported_date, as_of_date): counts how many week boundaries (Sundays) fall between the two dates, not days divided by 7.

structured_output.grain: One row per open or re-opened claim notified on or before the reporting date (@AsOfDate), aged on the days since its last payment up to that date, or since its reported date if nothing has been paid.
